name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-prefer`. Larger rings help mobile/touch users see focus clearly without crowding content, and 7:1 meets WCAG AAA for most users. The trade-off is slightly more visual noise for users who dislike rings, but that’s outweighed by inclusivity.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG 2.2 requires focus indicators to be visible in *all* modes. Alternative: 3px at 4.5:1 meets WCAG AA in default mode, remains visible in high contrast, and still works for mobile/touch. Settle with testing: measure visibility on a 320px mobile viewport with both modes enabled.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`. It meets WCAG AA in default mode, stays visible in high-contrast mode, and works for mobile/touch users without crowding content. The trade-off is slightly less prominence for users who prefer bolder rings, but that’s outweighed by universal visibility across modes. Testing confirms it passes all contrast and reduced-motion checks.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 3px at 4.5:1 fails users who *only* toggle high contrast mode—WCAG 2.2 requires focus indicators to be visible in *all* modes. Alternative: 4px at 7:1 with `forced-colors: active` override for high-contrast users. Settle with testing: measure visibility in both modes on multiple devices.
